text: Starling — the burn-server frontend. Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime, native Rust + candle, no Python in the loop.
Same UI, different engine. Single Axum process owns the model on the GPU.
broadcast_1_90s.wav — the same 90 seconds of Salzburg news as Post 1.
candle-native-flash backend: FlashAttention v2 + fused RmsNorm + fused interleaved RoPE.
14.6 ms per decode step. Encoder 4.6 s for 300 s of audio. 1.74× faster than candle 0.9.
Incremental KV cache + 8-frame boundary margin. Only new audio gets re-encoded.
Same captions, no Python. Next up: Voxtral-4B-TTS on the same Rust stack.
